record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: In the basic string effective theory with quantum corrections, which asymptotic solutions remain stable when a general fluid with equation of state parameter left arbitrary is coupled to the dilaton, despite the strong nonlinearities of the field equations?

evidence.quote:
3.2 Extensions to general tree-level cosmology for any ﬂuid parameter
For the basic string eﬀective theory with quantum corrections, ﬁnd all stable asymptotic solutions with a general ﬂuid coupled to the dilaton. This involves several technical diﬃculties because of the nonlinearity of the equations.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the four-dimensional low-energy string effective action including the leading higher-curvature (α′) quantum corrections, in the form

S = ∫ d^4x √(-g) e^{-φ} [ R + (∇φ)^2 + α' c (R_GB^2 + ...) ] + S_matter,

where φ is the dilaton, R_GB^2 = R_{μνρσ}R^{μνρσ} − 4 R_{μν}R^{μν} + R^2 is the Gauss–Bonnet curvature invariant, and S_matter describes a perfect fluid with energy density ρ and pressure p obeying a barotropic equation of state p = (γ − 1) ρ with γ ∈ ℝ treated as a free parameter. Assume a spatially flat FLRW metric ds^2 = −dt^2 + a(t)^2 δ_{ij} dx^i dx^j and that the fluid is coupled to the dilaton in the standard tree-level manner (i.e., its stress-energy enters the φ-equation through a coupling determined by the e^{−φ} prefactor).

Derive the autonomous dynamical system governing (H, φ̇, ρ) (where H = ȧ/a), classify all of its fixed points and asymptotic (t → ±∞) trajectories as functions of γ, and determine which of these asymptotic solutions are linearly (and, where possible, nonlinearly) stable. In particular, give a complete characterization, for every value of the equation-of-state parameter γ, of the stable asymptotic cosmological regimes of this corrected string-dilaton-fluid system.
artifact.status_search_result: Phase-space analyses of low-energy string cosmology with α' (Gauss–Bonnet) corrections and a barotropic fluid coupled to the dilaton have been carried out for specific equation-of-state values (e.g., radiation, dust, stiff matter), but a complete classification of all stable asymptotic solutions for arbitrary fluid parameter γ does not appear in the literature; the nonlinearity of the corrected field equations prevents a full classification. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Perfect fluids in string dilaton cosmology
status_evidence.snippet: Cosmological evolution based on the low-energy effective string theory with second-order curvature corrections and a modulus scalar field is investigated. Phase space analysis and stability of asymptotic solutions for multiple models.
status_evidence.claim: Stability analyses exist for particular models/fluid choices but not a complete classification over all γ.

status_evidence.title: Quantum Corrections for a Cosmological String Solution
status_evidence.snippet: Quantum corrections to cosmological string solutions modify singularity structure and asymptotic behavior.
status_evidence.claim: Quantum-corrected string cosmology asymptotics remain an active subject without a complete general-fluid classification.
